name: ai-approval-flow
intent: Let an agent propose a consequential action and let a human accept, amend or refuse it — with the reasoning visible and the outcome auditable.
sequence: The proposal renders inside ai:ai-soft-surface so its machine authorship is unmistakable
ai:ai-message-header attributes the output to a named agent
ai:ai-confidence-risk-badge states confidence and risk as labelled values
ai:ai-why-this-link exposes the rationale without requiring the user to ask
ai:ai-action presents at most three choices: primary confirms, secondary amends, tertiary dismisses
When requiresReview is true, the review signal renders above the action row before the primary is actionable
On primary, status moves to loading, then complete or error — never silently
The outcome is written to an audit trail and surfaced via ui:toast with an undo path when reversible
requiredRules: A human gesture is required before any state change
Confidence shown must be confidence the model produced
The rationale must be reachable in one interaction
Failure states must say what failed and what to do next
An applied change is either reversible or plainly labelled as not
forbiddenRules: No more than three visible actions
No approval flow whose primary action is pre-focused or pre-selected
No confidence value invented to fill the slot
No progress animation that does not track real work
